0022600206.text: The Toronto Raptors (5-4, 6th in the East) host the Memphis Grizzlies (6-3, 7th in the West) in Toronto's 10th game of the season, with the Raptors on a one-game winning streak while Memphis has lost three straight. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (out, knee bruise), Richie Saunders (out, knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness), and the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 128-96 win in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
